title: A lane brief must cite the standing decision it touches
trigger: 2026-10-24 (wave G3): the lane brief asked for a derived 01-05 numeral column on the product feature list, contradicting EX-07 (PR #670, 2026-10-23: no numerals on that list because the story chapters already carry "01 / 05"). The lane implemented it and re-pinned two tests; a correction commit removed it and added the opposite guard.
root_cause: The brief did not list the prior decisions and test pins that govern the surface it changed, so a standing decision was overridden implicitly and the lane re-pinned existing tests to match the new request.
rule: Before changing a surface, the brief lists the prior decisions and pins that govern it (grep the decisions index and the tests that pin the surface) and states explicitly when it overrides one; re-pinning an existing test in a lane requires a cited decision.
reuse_boundary: Surfaces that already carry a recorded decision or a test pin. A new surface with no prior decision needs no citation. Does not replace the Owner's authority to override a decision; it only makes the override explicit.

guard.path: tests/architecture/wg3-product-ledger.test.mjs ("WG3-04: the feature list is a hairline list with no numerals, all locales"; lands via PR #680, present on branch claude/marketing-project-audit-623e4t-wave-g3a at 2257d12 and NOT on main yet)
guard.negative_proof: Per the lane report on the #680 branch: reintroducing a numeral (profile-does__index, a derived two-digit numeral, a 0N tile prefix, or CSS counter() content) makes the test fail. Not re-run in this change and not verifiable on main until #680 merges: NOT VERIFIED on main.
